daily.today_energy: Your Mars energy is hitting different today. Channel that raw momentum into something meaningful—whether that's starting that project you've been doom-scrolling about or just owning a room with your presence. The vibes are aligned for action.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your person might need some reassurance today. If you're single, don't force connections—the universe is basically telling you to vibe with yourself first. Self-love is the real romance energy right now.
daily.career: Your ideas are actually fire today, but timing matters. Speak up in meetings or share that vision you've been sitting on. The universe is opening doors for those bold enough to walk through them. Trust your gut on decisions.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement—whether that's a walk, dancing, or a workout that actually feels good, not punishing. Listen to what makes you feel alive. Rest when you need it; pushing through burnout isn't the move.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to slow down and get curious about what you actually want, not what you think you should want. Mercury's vibe is giving reflection meets action—perfect for pivoting toward something more aligned with your soul.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, this is a sweet moment to check in without the pressure. Single? Stop forcing connections and let people come to you. Your energy is magnetic when you're genuinely doing your own thing, trust that.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now, but patience is the real move. Plant seeds this week rather than expecting instant harvest. Something you've been working on quietly is about to get noticed—just keep showing up.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for something gentler this week. Tune into what actually feels good instead of what's trending. Movement, rest, hydration—get back to basics and notice how different you feel when you listen to yourself.
